changes.comment: Add CryptoUtils.fromBase64Strict — a Result-returning base64 decode that rejects malformed input instead of silently salvaging it, unlike the Buffer-first fromBase64 which drops out-of-alphabet characters without complaint. Use it when the base64 came from somewhere you do not control. BrowserCryptoProvider.fromBase64 in @fgv/ts-web-extras now delegates to it, collapsing a duplicated decode loop.
